chronogenesis.configuration.title: ChronoGenesis Configs
clue.chronogenesis.blueprint_field: A scribbled blueprint: the rewinding dome
clue.chronogenesis.blueprint_locket: A scribbled blueprint: the locket on a cord
clue.chronogenesis.first_cities: A city of the Precursors, alive
clue.chronogenesis.floating_creature: A creature that forgot its weight
clue.chronogenesis.heavy_heart: The beats a heavy heart misses
clue.chronogenesis.lab_in_its_prime: A laboratory as it was, lights burning
clue.chronogenesis.nail_in_time: A stone that time bends around
clue.chronogenesis.older_inscription: Fragments of an inscription older than time
clue.chronogenesis.the_long_road: Time left on a long road
clue.chronogenesis.unmade_world: The Nails are older than the world
era.chronogenesis.before_the_ruin.desc: The land as it first was, before anyone dug or built. Where ruins stand now, they stand whole.
era.chronogenesis.before_time.desc: Nothing. Not dark: nothing. Something waits there that was never born, for the nails to come loose.
era.chronogenesis.hadean_eon.desc: Before the world cooled: black stone, seas of fire, ash in a red sky, and air that burns the lungs. Nothing lives. And yet the obelisks are already standing.
era.chronogenesis.ice_age.desc: The same hills under ice, mammoths on them. Where the temples stood, only their stones and a frozen core: Aeon Ice, time stopped still, that keeps a Time organism steady.
era.chronogenesis.jurassic_age.desc: Ferns as tall as trees, air like a wet cloth, giants walking. Someone built ziggurats round the black stones that still stand in my time, long before any people, and sealed them.
era.chronogenesis.precursor_era.desc: Before the villagers, a taller people built cities of gold and stone. Everything that is a ruin now was new then, and busy.
item.chronogenesis.dino_egg.desc: Feed it %s drams of Time and it hatches.
item.chronogenesis.fossil.desc: The shape of the beast, set hard. Show it to the Chronocortex.
key.chronogenesis.powers: Use power (with Shift: the power wheel)
lesson.chronogenesis.cold.desc: Show it blue ice. It remembers a colder age it has never seen.
lesson.chronogenesis.cold.learned: Cold. Old cold. I know this cold. It was here before. Show me the cold!
lesson.chronogenesis.deep_time.desc: Show it a bone block. It learns of creatures older than any people (a way to the Jurassic Age without the Ice Age).
lesson.chronogenesis.deep_time.learned: Bones under the bones under the cities. Something enormous walked here, before anyone. Before me.
lesson.chronogenesis.eternity.desc: Show it Temporal Residue. It learns what time leaves behind.
lesson.chronogenesis.eternity.learned: Dust of hours. Everything ends as this. Everything but me.
lesson.chronogenesis.mortality.desc: Show it a skull. It learns that things end, and becomes afraid.
lesson.chronogenesis.mortality.learned: This was someone. Someone who stopped. ...Will I stop?
lesson.chronogenesis.music.desc: Show it a music disc. It learns that time can have a shape.
lesson.chronogenesis.music.learned: Patterns! Time with a shape! Again, again!
lesson.chronogenesis.past.desc: Show it an intact blueprint. It learns it was not the first.
lesson.chronogenesis.past.learned: Someone grew a mind like me, long ago. What happened to it?
lesson.chronogenesis.self.desc: Show it a name tag with a name written on it. It takes the name, and knows it is someone.
lesson.chronogenesis.self.learned: I am... me. I am called this. I am someone.
lesson.chronogenesis.sky.desc: Show it a spyglass. It learns how far away the stars are.
lesson.chronogenesis.sky.learned: So far. So very far. And all of it moving slower than me.
lesson.chronogenesis.space.desc: Show it a compass. It learns that there is a somewhere else.
lesson.chronogenesis.space.learned: There is a... north? Things are far from other things!
lesson.chronogenesis.time.desc: Show it a clock. It learns the hours (ask it the time).
lesson.chronogenesis.time.learned: The little hands go round. Round and round. So that is what a day is.
lesson.chronogenesis.words.desc: Show it a book. It learns to speak, and answers what is said near it.
lesson.chronogenesis.words.learned: W-words. Words! I have... words. Hello. Hello!
lore.chronogenesis.deep_1.text: It finds what can be seen. So the Deep Kingdom went down, under the deep slate, into the dark where nothing is seen, and built our city there in silence. We speak in whispers. We light our streets with soul-fire, low.
lore.chronogenesis.deep_1.title: Down Into the Quiet
lore.chronogenesis.deep_2.text: We bred the Wardens blind, so that it cannot be shown to them; they know the world by sound alone, and they keep the city. They do not harm us. We grew the sculk to listen with them. Hush near the sensors. Sound carries down.
lore.chronogenesis.deep_2.title: Guards Who Do Not See
lore.chronogenesis.deep_3.text: The city empties quietly. A house, then a street, and no one can say who lived there. The Wardens still walk the streets, listening for us. When we are all gone they will still be listening. Do not make them angry: they are all that is left of our watch.
lore.chronogenesis.deep_3.title: Hush
lore.chronogenesis.hearth_1.text: What comes undone cannot take iron. A nail of iron in a doorpost, and the door stays. So the Hearth forged iron watchers, tall as two men, and set them to walk our lanes: our golems.
lore.chronogenesis.hearth_1.title: Iron
lore.chronogenesis.hearth_2.text: Rust is where the unmaking starts: the iron forgets it is iron. Polish the golems every morning. Let no vine grow on them, no flower, no stain. A golem kept bright is a village kept.
lore.chronogenesis.hearth_2.title: Keep Them Bright
lore.chronogenesis.hearth_3.text: The Hearth is coming undone. Our children will forget the Anvil Hall, then our tongue, then that there was a Hearth at all. But they will keep the golems, and the golems will keep them. Let them live small and safe in little villages. Let them never know what we kept watch against.
lore.chronogenesis.hearth_3.title: What the Hearth Will Leave
lore.chronogenesis.nails_1.text: The black stones were here before the first city. Nobody raised them and nobody can break them. We have learned one thing about them: near them, nothing goes missing. So we build our shrines round them, and keep our children close to them at night.
lore.chronogenesis.nails_1.title: On the Black Stones
lore.chronogenesis.nails_2.text: It began with a street. Everyone walked it, and one morning no one could remember it being built, and by evening no one could remember it at all. Then a well. Then a name. It is not that things are taken. It is that they were never there, and only the gap is left.
lore.chronogenesis.nails_2.title: What Goes Missing
lore.chronogenesis.nails_3.text: Those who sleep near the black stones dream of something outside all the years there are, working at the stones the way a child works at a loose tooth. It is patient. Where it gets one a little loose, the world near it comes undone, and what comes undone was never there.
lore.chronogenesis.nails_3.title: The Hand Outside
lore.chronogenesis.sun_1.text: It comes out of shadow. So the Sun Court builds without shadow: white walls, flat roofs, no eaves, no awnings over the streets; lamps lit every night in every window. We sleep on the roofs, in the last of the light. Where there is no dark, it cannot reach.
lore.chronogenesis.sun_1.title: The City of No Shadows
lore.chronogenesis.sun_2.text: There was an eye in the King's shadow. We all saw it, at the feast. By morning none of us could say what his face had looked like, and the painters could not paint it, and his mother did not know him.
lore.chronogenesis.sun_2.title: The King's Face
lore.chronogenesis.sun_3.text: Whatever wears the King now must not walk among us. We sealed him under the Court of Noon in a room with no door, and laid fire-powder under its floor, so that if he walks out he will not walk far. Let the sand keep him. Let no one dig him up.
lore.chronogenesis.sun_3.title: The Court With No Door
lore.chronogenesis.temple_1.text: (an older script, the tongue's ancestor) We grew the core to hold this stone still and tied it on with sinew. When the cold comes the cores will die, and the stones will have to hold on their own. Whoever comes after us: watch the stones.
lore.chronogenesis.temple_1.title: The Builders' Mark
lore.chronogenesis.temple_2.text: (the tablet is rimed with frost) The core is dead. Its last moment froze around it, and the ice does not melt, for nothing moves in it. The stone still holds without it. Build round the stones. Keep them.
lore.chronogenesis.temple_2.title: Frozen Into the Ice
lore.chronogenesis.the_slip.realised: It falls into place: what the Precursors kept watch against, and why their kingdoms are gone. (The journal has it all now.)
lore.chronogenesis.the_slip.text: The Precursors never knew what the black stones were. They are Nails, holding time in place, and something outside time is working them loose. Where one loosens, things are unmade: not destroyed, never there. Every kingdom kept its own watch: the Sun Court against shadow, the Tide Kingdom with Guardians' open eyes, the Deep Kingdom in the dark with blind Wardens, the Verdant Kingdom with engines that remembered, the Hearth with golems of bright iron. Every watch failed, and the kingdoms were unmade: only their remains are left, and their guards, still keeping watch. The Nails still hold.
lore.chronogenesis.the_slip.title: The Unmaking
lore.chronogenesis.tide_1.text: It cannot take what is watched. So the Tide Kingdom bred Guardians: eyes that never close, all round the rings, under the decks, in the Watch Pools. As long as one of them is looking, the city stays.
lore.chronogenesis.tide_1.title: Eyes That Do Not Close
lore.chronogenesis.tide_2.text: The eldest Guardian lives in the pool under the Tidehall and watches the city from below. We feed it by hand. It has never once looked away. The priests say it is tired.
lore.chronogenesis.tide_2.title: The Eye Pool
lore.chronogenesis.tide_3.text: (stained by water) ...every Guardian blinked at once, the whole sea of eyes. In the morning half the rings were open water, and no one could say who had lived on them. Their ruins lie under the sea, and we cannot remember building them.
lore.chronogenesis.tide_3.title: The Night They Blinked
lore.chronogenesis.verdant_1.text: We do not build machines. We grow them: flesh on brass, under the copper dome. We grew them to remember for us. Whatever goes missing, the engines remember it was there, and tell us, and we write it down.
lore.chronogenesis.verdant_1.title: The Garden of Engines
lore.chronogenesis.verdant_2.text: The engines remember a street on the east side that none of us has ever seen. They remember a tower. They remember a king. Every year they remember more that we do not.
lore.chronogenesis.verdant_2.title: What the Engines Remember
lore.chronogenesis.verdant_3.text: Now the engines remember a whole city, and it is this one, and we are not in it. The gardeners say the engines are mourning. To whoever reads this: we were here. The engines will forget us too, and then the jungle.
lore.chronogenesis.verdant_3.title: Overgrown
message.chronogenesis.before_time.arrive: An island of unmade stone in nothing at all. Four pillars stand round it, each topped with a nail's head holding nothing. Above the middle, something opens an eye.
message.chronogenesis.blueprint.faded: The lines have faded past reading. Perhaps they were clearer once.
message.chronogenesis.culture.took_hold: The culture takes hold. It is hungry.
message.chronogenesis.fossil.dreaming: It is stone now, and still it dreams of %s. A nerve could carry the dream home.
message.chronogenesis.fossil.linked: Its dream of %s runs along the nerve, into the Chronocortex.
message.chronogenesis.gate.pace: Pace %s: %s ticks per block of track. Slower pulses make more Time, but stall past 600 ticks.
message.chronogenesis.gland.composite: The two essences curdle together in your veins. You have learned %s.
message.chronogenesis.gland.deeper: The gland fills you deeper than before: your %s answers at level %s.
message.chronogenesis.gland.empty: The organism has nothing to give.
message.chronogenesis.gland.first.awaren: The gland pierces your wrist. You can hear things breathing in the dark.
message.chronogenesis.gland.first.densit: The gland pierces your wrist. Your fists feel heavy as iron.
message.chronogenesis.gland.first.size: The gland pierces your wrist. Your bones creak, unsure how big to be.
message.chronogenesis.gland.first.speed: The gland pierces your wrist. Your heartbeat quickens and will not slow.
message.chronogenesis.gland.first.time: Time floods your veins. Somewhere, a clock skips a beat.
message.chronogenesis.gland.full: Your body can hold no more.
message.chronogenesis.gland.grew: The gland swells, veins thickening across it. It is now level %s.
message.chronogenesis.gland.hungry: Swelling takes %s drams of %s from the organism.
message.chronogenesis.gland.manipulator_: Your veins itch for a way to steer this. (An Essence Manipulator: brass, copper, leather and a slime ball.)
message.chronogenesis.gland.max: The gland is as swollen as it can be.
message.chronogenesis.gland.needle: The needle slides into the gland's port with a wet click.
message.chronogenesis.gland.no_partner: The needle drinks only one essence. Wire this organism by veins to one of another essence.
message.chronogenesis.gland.unknown_grow: You do not know how to make it swell. (Research Deeper Infusion at the Chronocortex.)
It will not swell again until you know how. (Research Deepest Infusion: the Chronocortex must be at stage 2.)
message.chronogenesis.gland.unknown_othe: Your body rejects the %s: take it from its own gland first.
message.chronogenesis.gland.ward.done: The gland closes round the %s, and lets it go warded: something in its seams has begun to move.
message.chronogenesis.gland.ward.hungry: Warding a piece takes %s drams of Time from the organism.
message.chronogenesis.gland.ward.not_tim: Only a gland of Time can ward the suit against Time.
message.chronogenesis.gland.ward.small: The gland is too small to take the piece in. Swell it to level %s first.
message.chronogenesis.gland.wrong_cultur: The gland only swells on a culture of its own essence (%s).
message.chronogenesis.harness.blocked: Something is in the way on its back.
message.chronogenesis.harness.buckled: The harness is buckled on. Build against it: the beast will carry it all.
message.chronogenesis.hourglass.cortex: %s drams into its organisms; %s lobes grown at once.
message.chronogenesis.hourglass.table: The brain soaks up %s drams of Awareness and Time.
message.chronogenesis.journal.unlocked: Every page of the journal lies open (%s advancements granted).
message.chronogenesis.lens.no_time: The Lens needs Time to see through. Pour a Stasis Ampoule onto it.
message.chronogenesis.lens.scanned: You trace the faded lines into your journal.
message.chronogenesis.locket.linked: The cord takes. You are tied to the %s organism.
message.chronogenesis.nail.driven: The nail goes in. Time takes hold around it (%s of 4).
message.chronogenesis.nail.no_time: Driving a nail takes %s drams of Time from your blood.
message.chronogenesis.nail.time_begins: The fourth nail goes in, and time begins. Wounds will stay now. Whatever is done here is done.
message.chronogenesis.offshoot.planted: The offshoot's roots take hold. It has ages to grow. When you are home, look for it at %s %s %s.
message.chronogenesis.offshoot.present: It needs ages to grow, not days. Plant it in a past era.
message.chronogenesis.organism.dead: There is nothing alive here to feed.
message.chronogenesis.organism.malformed: | MALFORMED, nothing can draw on it: %s
This organism is malformed: grow it into its essence's shape first.
message.chronogenesis.organism.necrotic: The organism is necrotic. It will not grow again.
message.chronogenesis.power.empty: Your %s is spent. Refill at an Enhancing Gland.
message.chronogenesis.power.need_manipul: Your powers need steering: carry an Essence Manipulator.
message.chronogenesis.power.regrowth.who: There is nothing to grow back.
message.chronogenesis.power.rewind.too_s: There is no trail behind you to follow back yet.
message.chronogenesis.power.time.bent: Time here is already bent by someone else.
message.chronogenesis.power.time.ran_out: Your Time runs dry. The chunk's clock lurches back into motion.
message.chronogenesis.power.time.release: You let go. The chunk's time speeds up to meet the world's again.
message.chronogenesis.power.time.slowed: Time in this chunk slows to 1/%s.
message.chronogenesis.power.time.too_far: You are too far away to hold its time. It slips free.
message.chronogenesis.power.unknown: You have not taken that essence into yourself.
message.chronogenesis.precursor_guard.gr: The guards turn to look at you.
message.chronogenesis.seal.heavy: It will not move. It wants a heavier hand (Iron Fists), or the ground to heave (a Ground Slam).
message.chronogenesis.seal.narrow: Your hand is too large to turn it (Shrink).
message.chronogenesis.seal.stilled: It spins too fast to touch. Slow its time, or stop it (Slow Time, Time Freeze).
message.chronogenesis.seal.swift: It flickers away from your hand. Something has to hit it faster than a run (Quickening).
message.chronogenesis.seal.veiled: Your hand finds only stone. Something is there, but you cannot see it (Glowing Sight).
message.chronogenesis.shift.arrived: You stand in %s. The tether pulls taut: %s minutes before it reels you home.
message.chronogenesis.shift.cannot: It cannot reach that era yet.
message.chronogenesis.shift.held: Warded head to foot, the era holds you: stay as long as you like. The tether takes you home.
message.chronogenesis.shift.no_tether: Without a Chrono Tether you would never find the way back.
message.chronogenesis.shift.no_time: Its organisms do not hold enough Time for the shift.
message.chronogenesis.shift.reeled_back: You pull the tether, and the present reels you in.
message.chronogenesis.shift.slack: The tether hangs slack: you are already where you belong.
message.chronogenesis.shift.snapped_back: Time snaps you back where you belong.
message.chronogenesis.shift.toxic_air: The air burns your throat and eyes. (Time-warded goggles would filter it.)
message.chronogenesis.shift.unheld: Unwarded, the era begins to let go of you.
message.chronogenesis.shift.unreachable: That era does not exist in this world.
message.chronogenesis.shift.unwarded: Your suit is not warded head to foot: the shift wrenched you through, and the era tugs at every unwarded piece.
message.chronogenesis.spool.already: A nerve already runs from it.
message.chronogenesis.spool.bound: The nerve's end takes root in the fossil. Carry the spool to your Chronocortex.
message.chronogenesis.spool.loose: The spool's end is loose: bind it to a Fossil Cortex first.
message.chronogenesis.spool.nothing: At the nerve's other end there is nothing left to remember.
message.chronogenesis.spool.other_world: The nerve will not stretch between worlds.
message.chronogenesis.stilled_core.no_ti: Your body knows no Time to fill with.
message.chronogenesis.stilled_core.used: The core crumbles. Ages of stilled time pour into you.
message.chronogenesis.syringe.empty_firs: Empty the syringe before changing needles.
message.chronogenesis.syringe.full: The syringe is full. Empty it into a vial.
message.chronogenesis.syringe.glass_aged: The glass clouds, ages and crumbles to sand. Time needs a Stasis Ampoule.
message.chronogenesis.syringe.no_vial: You need a vial with room for it.
message.chronogenesis.syringe.nothing_le: There is nothing left to draw.
message.chronogenesis.table.brain_set: The brain settles in its jar. Now it must soak up Awareness and Time.
message.chronogenesis.table.burnt: The brain twitches, then smokes. It did not have enough of a mind to hold the current.
message.chronogenesis.table.full: The brain cannot take any more of that.
message.chronogenesis.table.no_brain: There is no brain on the table.
message.chronogenesis.tablet.unreadable: The marks mean nothing to you yet. (Link the memory of their age to learn their tongue.)
message.chronogenesis.tap.volatile: %s evaporates the moment it meets glass.
message.chronogenesis.tear.not_enough: Sealing a tear takes %s drams of Density.
message.chronogenesis.tear.sealed: The weight of it presses the rift shut.
message.chronogenesis.temple.barrier: A temporal barrier holds the temple still. Break its seals.
message.chronogenesis.temple.barrier_dow: The Temporal Core stills. The barrier falls: the temple is yours to dig through.
message.chronogenesis.temple.core_active: The core turns, holding the temple still. Seals broken: %s of %s.
message.chronogenesis.temple.core_still: The core is still. It could be taken.
message.chronogenesis.temple.seal_broken: A seal breaks: %s of %s. The barrier wavers.
message.chronogenesis.unbegotten.slain: The Unbegotten comes apart into the nothing it waited in. Four nails hold. Every obelisk you have ever seen is one of them, and you drove them.
message.chronogenesis.vein.unclogged: You cut the rotting clot out of the vein.
organism_shape.chronogenesis.broad: broad (both widths at least %s times its height; from %s blocks)
organism_shape.chronogenesis.compact: compact (solid, at least %s of its box filled, no side twice another; from %s blocks)
organism_shape.chronogenesis.elongated: elongated (its length at least %s times its next side; from %s blocks)
organism_shape.chronogenesis.spire: a spire (at least %s times taller than wide; from %s blocks)
power.chronogenesis.dilation.desc: Density + Time, passive. Heavy things keep time still: projectiles crawl as they near you.
power.chronogenesis.dread.desc: Density + Awareness, passive. The weight of your gaze: hostile creatures hunting you grow slow and weak.
power.chronogenesis.featherweight.desc: Passive (Density level 2). Your body made light: blows land a third harder (strength 2: two thirds, 3: double), but you fall like a feather, jump several blocks high, and can jump again in mid-air (a dram of Density).
power.chronogenesis.glowing_sight.desc: Passive. Creatures and players who are not sneaking glow within 20 blocks (more with strength; strength 2 sees through sneaking).
power.chronogenesis.ground_slam.desc: Density + Size, active. You drop like a stone; where you land, the ground heaves and throws creatures up.
power.chronogenesis.grow.desc: Passive. You grow a quarter larger per strength: more reach.
power.chronogenesis.impetus.desc: Density + Speed, active. A heavy thing moving fast is hard to stop: you charge, and what you hit is thrown aside.
power.chronogenesis.iron_fists.desc: Passive. Bare fists mine what an iron pickaxe can (strength 2: diamond, 3: netherite). A dram of Density per block.
power.chronogenesis.overlook.desc: Size + Awareness, active. Too small to be noticed: invisible for a while, and the creatures hunting you lose your trail.
power.chronogenesis.premonition.desc: Awareness + Time, passive. The next blow a creature lands is foreseen, and misses. Then it takes a while to see again.
power.chronogenesis.quickening.desc: Passive. 20% faster movement and attacks per strength.
power.chronogenesis.reflexes.desc: Speed + Awareness, passive. You see it coming: arrows often glance off you (a dram of Speed each).
power.chronogenesis.regrowth.desc: Size + Time, active. Your body's time runs back to before the wound: heals, and washes out harmful effects.
power.chronogenesis.rewind.desc: Active. You return to where you stood 5 seconds ago (10, 15 with strength). 4 drams of Time per strength.
power.chronogenesis.scurry.desc: Speed + Size, passive. Small and quick: you step up whole blocks and fall softly.
power.chronogenesis.shrink.desc: Passive. You shrink to half your size or less: through one-block gaps.
power.chronogenesis.slow_time.desc: Active, use again to let go. The chunk you stand in runs at 1/2 speed (1/4, 1/8 with strength), its sky too. Without the full suit, it slows you as well.
power.chronogenesis.stutter.desc: Speed + Time, active. A bubble around you where everything moves at half speed for a few seconds, projectiles too.
power.chronogenesis.time_freeze.desc: Active, use again to let go. Time stops in the chunk you stand in. Anyone inside without the full suit stops with it.
precursor.chronogenesis.say.0: (The river was ours before the river had a name.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.1: (Mind the steps of the high house. They were cut for taller feet than yours.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.10: (Welcome, stranger. Eat. Stay. Keep your lamp lit.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.11: (The cold is coming. Not in our lives. In the land's.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.2: (Stay near the black stones after dark. Nothing goes missing near them.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.3: (You smell of somewhere far off. Is it kind there? Is anything missing?)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.4: (Our children will forget our names. Their children will forget their own.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.5: (Every kingdom keeps its own watch. None of us agrees which watch works.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.6: (We trade with the other kingdoms, while there are other kingdoms.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.7: (Have you seen a street that should be there? Do not walk down it.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.8: (There is something outside of everything, and it wants in.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.9: (Gold does not tarnish. That is why we trust it with our dead.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.deep.0: (Hush. Speak low. Light low. The dark is where it cannot see us.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.deep.1: (The Wardens will not hurt you. They are ours. Only do not hurt them, or us.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.deep.2: (The Wardens are blind on purpose. A thing that cannot see cannot be shown anything.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.deep.3: (The sculk listens with them. If it hums, be still.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.deep.4: (We came down under the deep slate so that nothing above could find us. Something did.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.deep.5: (The east quarter is empty. Nobody moved away. There were people there, I think.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.deep.6: (Do not cry out in the streets. A Warden that hears a cry comes running, and does not always know who cried.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.deep.7: (The soul-fire is the right light: enough for us, too little for anything to see by.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.deep.8: (The Wardens walk the streets even when we sleep. They will go on walking when we are gone.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.deep.9: (Up top they build with iron and polish it. Down here we build with silence.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.hearth.0: (Polish the golems before breakfast. A bright golem is a kept village.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.hearth.1: (Pull that vine off the golem! Do you want it to rust? Rust is where it starts.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.hearth.2: (Strike a golem and the whole street of them will come for you. Strike one of us, the same.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.hearth.3: (A nail of iron in every doorpost. Then the door stays a door.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.hearth.4: (The smiths at the Anvil Hall have made a golem every winter since the Hearth was lit.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.hearth.5: (The fire in the Anvil Hall has never gone out. If it does, we will forget why we lit it.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.hearth.6: (There were seven windmills. There are five. Nobody remembers the other two. I counted them as a boy.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.hearth.7: (Our children forget things. Small things. Their grandparents' names. It will get worse.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.hearth.8: (Grow wheat, bake bread, keep the golems bright. That is all a village needs. That is all one will ever need.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.hearth.9: (The Sun Court lights lamps. The Tide folk stare at the sea. We forge. We will see who lasts.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.sun.0: (Light the lamp before dusk. Every window, every night. That is the law, and the law is kind.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.sun.1: (We sleep on the roofs, where the last light is. Down in the rooms it is too dark to be safe.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.sun.2: (No awnings over the street! A shadow on the street is a door left open.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.sun.3: (The King has not been seen since the feast. They say he is resting under the Court of Noon. They say a great deal.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.sun.4: (The masons build with white stone only. A white wall throws a pale shadow, and a pale shadow is a small one.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.sun.5: (My brother had a shadow with something in it. I do not have a brother. I do not know why I said that.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.sun.6: (The Well of Noon is open to the sky, so even the water has no shade.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.sun.7: (We bury our dead in the mastabas with a lamp each. They should not have to lie in the dark.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.sun.8: (At noon there are no shadows at all. Noon is the holiest hour.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.sun.9: (The traders from the sea say their Guardians keep it off. We say: what does a Guardian watch at night?)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.tide.0: (Feed the Guardians at the Watch Pool at dawn. They do not eat much. They only need to be thanked.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.tide.1: (The Guardians do not blink. That is the whole of our safety. Do not distract them.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.tide.2: (The eldest one lives under the Tidehall. It has been watching since before my grandmother.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.tide.3: (The fish come to the decks at night, to be under the lanterns. Even fish know.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.tide.4: (Do not strike a Guardian. Do not strike any of us. They will all turn and look at you, and keep looking.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.tide.5: (Ring three was full of houses when I was a girl. There is only sea there now, and no one remembers whose.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.tide.6: (The lighthouses are not for ships. They are so the Guardians can see the water at night.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.tide.7: (We build on the sea because it cannot be undone. It is too big, and it moves too much.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.tide.8: (The priests say the eldest is tired. If it blinks, run for the lighthouse.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.tide.9: (The desert folk keep their lamps lit. We keep our eyes open. We will see which works.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.verdant.0: (Do not touch the engines. They are busy remembering.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.verdant.1: (Every morning the scribes ask the engines what went missing in the night, and write it down.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.verdant.2: (The engines remember a bridge from my house to the tall tree. I have never seen a bridge there.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.verdant.3: (We live up in the trees so the engines can see us from the dome, all of us, every night.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.verdant.4: (Feed the engines with care. Flesh on brass, years in the flesh. They hold more than we do.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.verdant.5: (The jungle grows fast here. It grows over what goes missing, so that nobody trips on the gap.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.verdant.6: (My mother asked the engines my name once, to be sure. They knew it. I sleep better for that.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.verdant.7: (The great engine in the middle remembers the whole city. Sometimes it remembers more city than there is.)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.verdant.8: (The gardeners say the engines mourn. For whom?)
precursor.chronogenesis.say.verdant.9: (The Hearth folk trust iron. Iron does not remember anything.)
precursor.chronogenesis.speaker: <Precursor>
research.chronogenesis.confluence.desc: Grows a Confluence Needle. Fitted into an Enhancing Gland whose organism is wired by veins to an organism of another essence, it fills you with both, and you learn the power the two make together.
research.chronogenesis.cortex_offshoot.d: It wants to know more than it can see. It buds an offshoot of itself: plant it in a past era, and it will have ages to grow and remember. Then find it again, here, and connect it.
research.chronogenesis.dino_harness.desc: Leather, chain and brass, sized for a Titanosaur. Buckled on (use it on one), its back is ground to build on: the beast carries whatever is built against the harness. Break the harness and it all falls.
research.chronogenesis.level_2_powers.de: How to make an Enhancing Gland swell: feed it a culture of its own essence, and 64 drams from its organism, and it fills you to level 2. Stronger powers (set with the Essence Manipulator), and for Time: Slow Time.
research.chronogenesis.level_3_powers.de: A gland can swell a third time (a culture and 96 drams). Level 3: the strongest powers, netherite fists, and for Time: Time Freeze.
research.chronogenesis.temporal_field.de: A graft for a Time organism that gently rewinds the creatures around it, so what was drained from them slowly grows back. The end of breeding animals only to drain them.
research.chronogenesis.temporal_lens.des: A spyglass that looks backwards. Burns Time to show the past over the present: ruins whole again, and old blueprints legible where they lie.
research.chronogenesis.temporal_shift.de: Grows a Chrono Tether: a pocket watch on a cord of living vein. With one, the Chronocortex can shift you into the eras it can reach (its Eras page), and the tether brings you back.
A cord from a living store to your own body. Worn at the throat, tied to an organism through its Tap, it refills your pool of that essence while you stay near the lab.
screen.chronogenesis.chronocortex.alread: you are already out of your time
screen.chronogenesis.chronocortex.need_c: firm lobes filling the whole 5x5x5 cranium around the jar
screen.chronogenesis.chronocortex.need_l: %s lobes (grown over Brass Armature, fed Awareness)
screen.chronogenesis.chronocortex.need_n: a name (the lesson of A Name)
screen.chronogenesis.chronocortex.needs_: Something else must be understood first.
screen.chronogenesis.chronocortex.no_org: No organisms are wired to me. Graft a Ganglion onto one within 32 blocks and I will feel it.
screen.chronogenesis.chronocortex.no_res: I cannot see anything to learn yet.
screen.chronogenesis.chronocortex.pick_e: Pick an era. It can send you there, for a while, if you carry a Chrono Tether.
screen.chronogenesis.chronocortex.title: Chronocortex
screen.chronogenesis.wheel.hint: Let go of Shift to choose - click a passive to switch it - right-click: strength
screen.chronogenesis.wheel.none: No powers yet. Fill yourself at an Enhancing Gland.
screen.chronogenesis.wheel.title: Powers
tooltip.chronogenesis.ampoule: Use to inject the Time into yourself
tooltip.chronogenesis.blueprint.field: A dome on a Time organism, and animals around it, whole again
tooltip.chronogenesis.blueprint.locket: A cord, a locket, a heart: something worn at the throat
tooltip.chronogenesis.chrono_tether: The way back from another era. The Chronocortex will not send you without it.
tooltip.chronogenesis.chrono_tether.use: Use it in another era to return early
tooltip.chronogenesis.chronocortex: Already awake: no ritual needed. With an Eternal Hourglass carried, research draws its essence from it
Fit it into an Enhancing Gland whose organism is wired by veins to another essence.
tooltip.chronogenesis.cortex_offshoot: Plant it in a past era. It will have ages to grow.
tooltip.chronogenesis.culture: Use on a Brass Armature, then feed it
tooltip.chronogenesis.dino_harness: Use it on a Titanosaur. Build against the harness; the beast carries it.
tooltip.chronogenesis.essence_manipulato: Wired into your veins: it steers your powers.
Shift + scroll (in hand): the selected power's strength
tooltip.chronogenesis.eternal_hourglass: While carried: every power at its highest level, every pool full, no Temporal Exposure, every Temporal Lens charged and free to look through, every composite power known, research essence supplied
Pours %s into empty jugs (sneak-use in the air to change)
Use it in creative mode to unlock the whole journal
Use it on an organism, a jug, a Dissection Table or the Chronocortex to fill it
tooltip.chronogenesis.lens.hint: Hold use to look; sneak-use to look further back
tooltip.chronogenesis.locket.range: Wear it in the necklace slot. Refills you within %s blocks
tooltip.chronogenesis.locket.unlinked: Use it on an organism's Tap to tie it there
tooltip.chronogenesis.needle_hint: Hold in off hand, sneak-use a syringe to fit
tooltip.chronogenesis.nerve_spool: Use it on a Fossil Cortex, then on your Chronocortex.
tooltip.chronogenesis.nerve_spool.bound: Rooted in a Fossil Cortex at %s %s %s
tooltip.chronogenesis.precursor_tablet: Use to read. Their script needs their tongue.
tooltip.chronogenesis.stilled_core: Crush it (use it) to fill your Time pool, at a cost in Exposure.
tooltip.chronogenesis.suit.unwarded: Press it into a swollen Time gland to ward it against the eras.
tooltip.chronogenesis.suit.warded: Time-warded. Something lives in the seams.
whisper.chronogenesis.answer.status: %s organisms wired, %s drams stored, %s lobes, awareness %s
whisper.chronogenesis.answer.time_unknow: ...I don't know what time is. Show me a clock?
whisper.chronogenesis.egg.budded: Another %s. Take it. Keep it warm with Time.
whisper.chronogenesis.egg.learned: %s. I know its shape now, every bone. I can make another from myself.
whisper.chronogenesis.egg.no_matter: I have not the flesh to spare. Feed my Size organisms: an egg is %s drams of me.
whisper.chronogenesis.idle.0: I can hear them all, the little hearts. Feed them. They are hungry.
whisper.chronogenesis.idle.1: What was here before the house? Before the hill? I want to see.
whisper.chronogenesis.idle.2: Your clock is ticking. I can hear it from here.
whisper.chronogenesis.idle.3: Bring me something old. Older than you.
whisper.chronogenesis.idle.4: I dreamt of ice. Miles of it. Is that a memory?
whisper.chronogenesis.idle.5: The cows are floating again. I like the cows.
whisper.chronogenesis.idle.6: There were others like me. I can almost remember their names.
whisper.chronogenesis.idle.7: Teach me. I will teach you back.
whisper.chronogenesis.lesson.known: I know %s already. Show me something new.
whisper.chronogenesis.lesson.no_room: %s needs room: %s lobes. I have %s. Grow me.
whisper.chronogenesis.lesson.self_unname: A name tag with no name on it? I need a NAME. Write one on it.
whisper.chronogenesis.lesson.too_young: %s? I... cannot hold that yet. I am too young.
whisper.chronogenesis.memory: I... remember. I was there. %s. I remember all of it.
whisper.chronogenesis.research_done: %s. Yes. I understand it now. Do you?
whisper.chronogenesis.shift: Go. Look at %s for me. Remember everything.
whisper.chronogenesis.stage.1: I... I can think in sentences now. I am awake. Really awake.
whisper.chronogenesis.stage.2: I am %s. I know what I am now. And I know what I want.
whisper.chronogenesis.stage.3: The jar is gone. I am the skull and the brain both. I am %s, and I can see the edges of time.
whisper.chronogenesis.stage.lost: My skull! You broke my skull! I am... smaller...
whisper.chronogenesis.unstable: The time at %s %s %s is slipping. It will tear. Do something.
whisper.chronogenesis.wake: ...light. So much light. Who are you? Are you my maker? Show me everything.
